changelog.title: MY DECK, REMANTLER AND SMELTER
changelog.body:
My Deck now groups your cards into Units, Spells and Trinkets and shows six cards to a row. Bars under IN YOUR DECK show how full your deck and trinkets are, and the tab counts now count every copy.
A hint along the bottom explains it: click a card to move one copy between your deck and storage, right-click to inspect it.
The Remantler and Smelter also show six cards to a row.

changelog.title: MENU TIDY-UP
changelog.body:
Every section of the menu now has its own colour, and tabs, buttons and pop-ups look the same on every page. Buttons that move you on are green, and buttons that delete something are red.
Options and Profile now have a background, and the panels on the Multiplayer pages now show properly over their background picture.
Replay Tutorial is now on the Profile > Stats page. The Missions page no longer shows a note about runs, which gives the missions more room.
